such as food and environmental samples. With SERS, it is possible to analyze these
samples without altering their chemical composition, ensuring the accurate detection
of contaminants or trace analytes, while minimizing the risk of false positives or false
negatives. This capability makes SERS an invaluable tool for food safety assessment,
quality control, and environmental monitoring, for which preservation of sample integrity
is paramount [80–82].
